Protest planned against E20 toll road after paper leak

A protest is planned in support of Tehseen Poonawala's demand for a review of the E20 toll road. The protest will take place on August 4th at the Parliament grounds. Tehseen Poonawala has announced that she will be present at the protest. The taxi union has threatened to block traffic on the E20 toll road if their demands are not met.
